name: Phenobarbital
description: Phenobarbital facts: uses in epilepsy and alcohol withdrawal, dosing basics, risks, interactions, overdose, withdrawal, and legal access.
quick: Phenobarbital is a long-acting barbiturate used mainly for seizures and, in hospitals, for alcohol withdrawal. It is one of the oldest medicines still in use. It is a Schedule IV controlled substance with a narrow margin between a helpful and a dangerous dose.
facts: Sezaby (injection for newborn seizures); most products are unbranded
Liver (CYP2C9, CYP2C19); strongly induces other liver enzymes

blocks.p: Phenobarbital is used to prevent and treat seizures and, in hospitals, increasingly to manage severe alcohol withdrawal. Most oral phenobarbital in the US is sold under older, unapproved-drug status; Sezaby is an FDA-approved injection for seizures in newborns.[[1]]

It is inexpensive and recommended by the World Health Organization as an essential antiseizure medicine, but newer medicines are usually preferred because of sedation, interactions, and overdose risk.
Phenobarbital dosing is individualized and often guided by blood levels. The figures below are typical ranges from labeling and are not personal dosing advice.[[1]]

head: Use
Typical adult dose
Notes
rows: 60 to 200 mg a day, once or in divided doses
Target blood level often 15 to 40 mcg/mL

sections.q: What are the risks and side effects of phenobarbital?

blocks.p: **Common side effects** include drowsiness, slowed thinking, depression, and, in children and older adults, paradoxical hyperactivity or confusion.[[1]]
**Serious risks** include fatal overdose, especially with alcohol or opioids; serious skin reactions; bone thinning with long-term use; and birth defects.[[1]]

blocks.warn: Unlike benzodiazepines, barbiturates have no ceiling on their sedative effect. Overdose can stop breathing even without other drugs, and there is no antidote.

head: Combined with
What happens

sections.q: What does phenobarbital overdose look like?

blocks.p: Phenobarbital overdose causes deep sleepiness, confusion, slurred speech, loss of reflexes, low body temperature, slowed breathing, low blood pressure, and coma. It is more dangerous than benzodiazepine overdose because there is no reversal drug.[[1]]

emergency.title: If someone may have overdosed
items: Call 911 if the person is unresponsive, hard to wake, or breathing slowly.
For advice when the person is awake and stable, call Poison Help at 1-800-222-1222 (US, free, 24 hours).
If opioids could be involved, including pills not from a pharmacy, give naloxone if you have it. Naloxone does not reverse phenobarbital, but it will not harm the person.
Stay with the person and place them on their side if they are drowsy or vomiting.

blocks.p: Hospitals treat severe overdose with breathing support and, sometimes, activated charcoal or dialysis to remove the drug.

sections.q: What is phenobarbital withdrawal like, and how long does it last?

blocks.p: Regular use causes physical dependence. Barbiturate withdrawal is among the most dangerous drug withdrawals.[[1]]

timeline.title: Severe withdrawal
timeline.text: Seizures and delirium can occur and can be fatal.

timeline.title: Recovery
timeline.text: Gradual return of sleep and mood.

blocks.warn: Never stop phenobarbital suddenly. In people with epilepsy, stopping can trigger prolonged seizures. Tapers are slow, often over weeks to months.

sections.q: How do you get phenobarbital legally in the US?

blocks.p: In the United States, phenobarbital is a Schedule IV controlled substance. The only legal way to get it is with a prescription from a clinician registered with the Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA), filled by a licensed pharmacy. Depending on state law, that can be a physician, nurse practitioner, or physician assistant.[[2]]

ul: **Refills:** a Schedule IV prescription can be refilled up to five times within six months of the date it was written. After that, a new prescription is needed.[[3]]

**Telehealth:** federal flexibilities let DEA-registered clinicians prescribe Schedule II to V medicines after a telemedicine visit, without a prior in-person exam, through December 31, 2026. A permanent DEA rule was under final review in late 2026. State rules can be stricter.[[4]]
**Monitoring:** prescribers and pharmacists in most states check a prescription drug monitoring program, a database of controlled-substance prescriptions, before prescribing or dispensing.

**Pharmacies:** a legitimate pharmacy always requires a valid prescription, has a licensed pharmacist available, and is licensed in the state it ships to. The FDA's BeSafeRx tool and the NABP's safe pharmacy list help confirm a pharmacy is real.[[5]][[6]]

blocks.p: **Traveling:** keep the medicine in its original pharmacy container and carry a copy of the prescription. Check the rules of the destination country before travel, because many countries restrict controlled medicines or require a permit.

Yes, but only with a valid prescription and only from a pharmacy licensed in your state. Many licensed pharmacies, including mail-order pharmacies run by insurers, fill phenobarbital prescriptions online and ship them. Buying phenobarbital from a website that does not require a prescription is illegal, and the product is often fake.[[5]][[7]]

steps: A clinician evaluates you in person or by telemedicine and decides whether phenobarbital is appropriate.
The prescription goes to a pharmacy
Prescriptions for controlled medicines are usually sent electronically, straight from the prescriber to the pharmacy you choose.
The pharmacy checks and fills it
A pharmacist verifies the prescription and your identity, then dispenses the medicine in person or by mail.

blocks.p: **Signs that an online seller is illegal:**

ul: It sells phenobarbital with no prescription, or after only a short online questionnaire.
It takes orders through social media, messaging apps, or email.
It asks for payment in cryptocurrency, gift cards, or money transfers.
It has no US street address, no state pharmacy license, and no pharmacist to speak to.
Its prices are far below those of ordinary pharmacies, or it ships from another country.

blocks.p: The FDA's BeSafeRx tool links to each state's license lookup, and the National Association of Boards of Pharmacy lists verified online pharmacies.[[5]][[6]]

How long does phenobarbital stay in your system?
Its half-life averages about 79 hours, so it takes 2 to 3 weeks to clear fully.
